messages:
incident-bot: P1 Alert — elevated 5xx rate for gateway-service (us-west-2). Error-rate jumped to ~15% over last 5m, downstream timeouts increasing, customer-facing latency spike. Paging oncall.
oncall-maria: on it. I'm pulling graphs now — link to dashboard: https://console.internal/redwood/dashboards/gateway-errors (looks real-time)
sre-jordan: seeing same. SLO alert fired + request volume unchanged => something upstream or a fanout regression. Any deployments in last 30m?
eng-raj: quick check: we had a small routing tweak rolled 12m ago (fast-fanout flag) — rolling that back now. Will update when toggled.
infra-lee: enabling short-circuit circuit breaker on the edge layer for us-west-2 to cut downstream blast radius. Threshold -> 10% 5xx for 30s. (will push config)
oncall-maria: thanks @eng-raj @infra-lee. tagging @product-ana for customer impact visibility.
eng-raj: turned off fast-fanout via feature flag console. Command shown in audit logs. Re-evaluating.
ops-bot: autoscale added 4 instances to gateway pool in us-west-2 to reduce queueing.
sre-jordan: logs show a spike in 502s with path /v1/generate -> upstream timeout to model-service v2. Stack traces show a retry storm.
eng-raj: looking at model-service traces — there's a bug in the retry/backoff code that causes immediate retries on 502. Opening a hotfix PR now.
eng-raj: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/model-service/pull/1743 — applying exponential backoff patch + idempotency guard.
eng-raj: deploying hotfix to canary (2 nodes) now.
infra-lee: circuit breaker applied. Also downgraded fanout concurrency to 8 per request for us-west-2 to reduce load.
oncall-maria: monitoring error% — dropped from 15% -> 6% in last 8 mins :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident state changed -> mitigated (partial). Continue monitoring for 30m. Please do not close until runbook follow-up tasks are created.
product-ana: customers with high QPS may have seen failed requests between 12:23–12:40. Preparing message for status page. ETA for full recovery?
sre-jordan: canary looks good. Planning full rollout of hotfix in 10m if no regressions. I'll coordinate.
eng-raj: full rollout started — deploy job: deploy/model-service v2026-03-15-hotfix-1743
ops-bot: deploy completed to prod in us-west-2 at 12:58 UTC. Health checks ok.
oncall-maria: final error-rate flattened ~1.2% last 5m. Latency back to baseline.
incident-bot: Incident state changed -> resolved (after mitigations and deploy). Marked P1 resolved by oncall-maria.
sre-jordan: follow-up items — we need immediate runbook updates and alert tuning. Noting items below.
eng-raj: action: add retry/backoff unit tests + backpressure test in chaos suite. Owner: eng-raj. Due: 2026-03-20.
infra-lee: action: add a config flag to make circuit-breaker auto-escalate to regional fallback when 5xx > 8% for 1m. Owner: infra-lee. Due: 2026-03-22.
sre-jordan: action: update runbook 'gateway-5xx' — add step to toggle fanout flag, circuit-breaker thresholds, and when to scale dedicated capacity. Owner: sre-jordan. Due: 2026-03-18.
oncall-maria: action: adjust alerting — change pager threshold for gateway 5xx from 5% to 8% for noisier paths, and add synthetic test for /v1/generate every 30s. Owner: oncall-maria. Due: 2026-03-16.
product-ana: action: status page draft + customer outreach for affected tenants. Owner: product-ana. Due: 2026-03-15 COB.
eng-raj: created follow-up ticket: INFRA-7821 (hotfix postmortem + tests). Link: https://tickets.internal/INFRA-7821
sre-jordan: quick note for runbook language: include exact kubectl rollback snippet and feature-flag console path. Example:
```
# rollback example
kubectl -n prod set image deploy/gateway gateway=redwood/gateway:v2026-03-14-7
# feature flag toggle: https://console.internal/flags/fast-fanout -> OFF
```
infra-lee: add a monitoring dashboard panel for retry-rate and retry-latency per upstream. Will do.
oncall-maria: adding post-incident brief to #postmortems and scheduling a 30m blameless debrief tomorrow 15:00 UTC. Inviting SRE/ENG/Infra/Product.
product-ana: noted. I have a list of affected customers; will sync with CS before posting on status.
sre-jordan: any follow-ups on on-call noise? If alerts keep firing, escalate to dedicated capacity runbook.
eng-raj: will send PR for tests and link it in INFRA-7821 once green.
oncall-maria: closing the page for now. If anyone observes regression, re-open thread or page the oncall.
ops-bot: reaction :white_check_mark: recorded.
incident-bot: incident timeline attached to ticket INFRA-7821. Auto-close thread in 72h if no new activity.
